SELECT track_versions.id, track_versions.track_id, track_versions.number, track_versions.name, track_versions.content_hash, track_versions.redacted_track_hash, track_versions.revision_key, track_versions.manifest, track_versions.discovery, track_versions.state, track_versions.created_at, track_versions.published_at, track_versions.creator_test_run_id, track_versions.rating_sum, track_versions.rating_count, track_versions.verified_finishers 
FROM track_versions JOIN tracks ON tracks.id = track_versions.track_id JOIN (SELECT track_versions.track_id AS track_id, max(track_versions.number) AS number 
FROM track_versions 
WHERE track_versions.state = ? GROUP BY track_versions.track_id) AS anon_1 ON anon_1.track_id = track_versions.track_id AND anon_1.number = track_versions.number 
WHERE tracks.owner_id = ? AND track_versions.state = ? AND tracks.archived IS 0 ORDER BY track_versions.created_at DESC, track_versions.id
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
